diagnosis: Endometrioid stromal sarcoma of the peritoneum
legend: Irregularly shaped islands of tumour infiltrate peritoneal fibroconnective tissue.

diagnosis: Endometrioid stromal sarcoma of the peritoneum
legend: The tumour is composed of uniform, oval cells with scant cytoplasm associated with a proliferation of small blood vessels.

This low grade tumour infiltrates the colonic wall and adjacent adipose tissue. The irregularly shaped islands of tumour are composed of uniform, oval cells with scanty cytoplasm and contain a proliferation of small blood vessels.
